description: Tier-B CC-BY (3.0/4.0) + CC-BY-SA (3.0/4.0) per-work attribution-chain tracker. Wikimedia Commons + Mutopia + IMSLP CC-BY portions. Attribution chain MUST propagate to every derivative baien-distill artifact (G8 mandatory). For CC-BY-SA: share-alike propagation tag flags downstream tagging. NOT fleet-internal carve-out (unlike NHK Tier-B) — CC-BY/CC-BY-SA works are publishable provided attribution chain preserved.

attributionText.description: Required attribution string per CC license. Format: '{author} / {work-title} / {cc-license-version} / {source-url}'

downstreamShareAlikePropagationRequired.description: true for CC-BY-SA-{3.0,4.0} (share-alike condition propagates to derivative artifacts); false for CC-BY (attribution only)

sourceUrl.description: Source URL for attestation provenance (not for active fetch — G4 PASSIVE-ONLY)

snapshotCid.description: IPFS CID of pinned snapshot of this work

publicDomainStatusAttestationCid.description: Cross-reference to per-work publicDomainStatusAttestation (work is Tier-B classified)

wikimediaLicenseTemplate.description: If sourceArchive is Wikimedia Commons: exact MediaWiki license template tag (e.g. 'Cc-by-4.0', 'Cc-by-sa-3.0', 'GFDL-1.2')

mutopiaLicenseTag.description: If sourceArchive is Mutopia: Mutopia per-piece license tag
